record.name: systeme.io
record.one_liner: Systeme.io public API for managing contacts, tags, campaigns, funnels, courses, and more via RESTful endpoints.

auth.notes: Authentication is performed by attaching the API key to the X-API-Key header of each request, generated from the profile settings in the dashboard.

access.notes: Users can generate public API keys directly from their dashboard profile settings under the 'MCP & API keys' section.

api_surface.notes: The API adheres to RESTful conventions, supports cursor-based pagination and merge patch (PATCH with application/merge-patch+json).

mcp.notes: Mentioned in the help center under 'Model Context Protocol (MCP)' and referenced in relation to creating API keys and limitations on editing/deleting certain funnels via MCP.

buildability.reasoning: The API offers self-serve credential generation from the dashboard, clearly documented REST endpoints, and standard API key authentication via the X-API-Key header.

evidence.claim: The API adheres to RESTful conventions and uses the X-API-Key header for authentication.
Users can generate API keys by going to Settings, MCP & API keys, and clicking Create under Public API keys.
Code examples are provided in Shell, Node, Ruby, PHP, and Python.
